name: A King's Tribute
label: Quest
description: Magni Bronzebeard honors Sully Balloo with a memorial in Ironforge. Granite from Lordaeron gives the fallen dwarf a lasting place in his people's memory.

clips.title: The story
paras: Magni Bronzebeard honors Sully Balloo with a memorial in Ironforge. Granite from Lordaeron gives the fallen dwarf a lasting place in his people's memory.

King Magni Bronzebeard ordered a monument for Sully Balloo, a dwarf who died serving his people. Grand Mason Marblesten carved it from fine granite brought from Lordaeron's war-torn lands. The memorial now stands in Ironforge, honoring soldiers whose sacrifices help preserve the dwarven kingdom.

When told the monument is complete, Magni reflects on stone and mortality. Carved rock can never equal a brave dwarf's life, he knows, but he hopes the memorial endures. Generations walking Azeroth may then remember the heroes who bled to secure their tomorrow.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, such fine stone comes from Lordaeron. Such a shame the land is in such shambles.
But the Memorial came out quite well! I should think the King will be most pleased with it.
Now if you will, please send word to His Majesty that the Memorial is complete as requested.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The granite seems but a small token compared to a great dwarf's life. But no dwarf shall last on this planet for eternity.

Let us just hope that the memorial stands as a reminder to those who will trod the great Azeroth of the future. Lest we not forget it is for them that brave soldiers such as Sully Balloo so valiantly gave their lives.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
